name: Run Bot

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 */6 * * *"   # backup: agar chain toot jaye to har 6 ghante me dobara start

# Ek hi time pe ek hi bot chale (do instance same token pe chalne se conflict hota hai).
# Naya run purane ke khatam hone tak queue me wait karega.
concurrency:
  group: rarebot
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  actions: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  run:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 355
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
          cache: pip

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install -r requirements.txt

      # 5h 30m baad agla run trigger hota hai; wo queue me ruka rahega
      # jab tak ye run 5h 45m pe khatam na ho. Isse gap bahut kam rehta hai.
      - name: Schedule next run
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          nohup bash -c 'sleep 19800; gh workflow run bot.yml --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"' >/dev/null 2>&1 &

      - name: Start bot
        env:
          API_ID: ${{ secrets.API_ID }}
          API_HASH: ${{ secrets.API_HASH }}
          BOT_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.BOT_TOKEN }}
          WORK_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/work
        run: timeout --signal=SIGINT 20700 python bot.py || true
